fields: MembershipSHA256: raw 32-byte digest of complete frozen membership
external_inputs: One externally fixed seed byte string
Explicit declared coverage plan, including an explicit empty plan only when that is the planned scope
component_role_input.trust_boundary: Opaque digests cannot prove graph completeness, source relationships, coverage correctness or known flags. A future runner must bind exact count/order/fields, seed and plan to independently frozen full provenance/truth metadata before Assign.

membership_encoding.lp: u64BE exact byte length followed by exact bytes
sequence: For each distinct member ID, sorted by exact case-sensitive UTF-8 byte order: LP(member ID)
For each distinct tuple sorted lexicographically by From, Kind, To: LP(From), LP(Kind), LP(To)
membership_encoding.relationship_endpoints: Both endpoints must be declared member IDs. Self-edges are permitted; duplicate tuples are refused.
membership_encoding.normalization: None. No Unicode, case, whitespace, path or source normalization is inferred.
membership_encoding.digest: SHA256 of the complete encoded bytes
membership_encoding.sideband_fields: Component ID, original group ID and known-containing flag are separate immutable metadata and must be bound to the same complete graph snapshot. They are not encoded by this membership helper.
membership_encoding.source_binding_limit: This encoding hashes declared member IDs and edge tuples only. External code/artifact/policy pins must be included in future declared immutable identities or bound through the separately frozen full graph/source snapshot. No missing member, source pin, semantic edge or omitted relationship is discovered here.

ordering_encoding.unknown_only: Not counted or hashed as known. Preserve whole unknown-only components in development_train provenance accounting. Members of a known-containing component follow its whole-component role while unknown members remain unknown and label/cost/Top-ineligible.

allocation.remainder_step: descending fractional remainder; ties train, validation, calibration
allocation.coverage: Only explicit future-plan requirements are checked; this prototype adds no requirement for every prototype in every role, 2,400 per development fit, fresh groups or repository count.
allocation.failure: Return a fixed refusal code and partial counters, with no assignments returned. Do not split groups, shrink existing floors or search a replacement seed.

maintainer_implementation_bounds.byte_preflight: Checked additions account for every u64/LP field before copies and Buffer.Grow. Refuse overflow or excess; Grow once for the exact declared encoded length.
maintainer_implementation_bounds.cross_component_overlap: Flatten member ID plus owner index into one bounded slice, sort, and compare neighbors. No cross-component member-pair loop, map or lock.
maintainer_implementation_bounds.scope: Implementation safety bounds for private maintainer tooling; not scientific readiness gates or measured runtime-hint savings.
